title: Scaling and Analytical Approximation of Porous Electrode Theory for Reaction-limited Batteries
authors: Shakul Pathak and Martin Z. Bazant
abstract: Porous electrode theory (PET) provides essential insights into electrochemical states, but its computational complexity hinders real-time control and obscures scaling relations. abstract: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), the most toxic and carcinogenic toxin produced by Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus, poses a major risk to food <mark>safety</mark> and public health due to its frequent occurrence in cereals and derived products. abstract: In this study, CoCrFeNi high-entropy alloy coatings were prepared on Q235 steel substrates by direct current electrodeposition.
